answer: One canonical 45-station graph consumes committed P0/P0-M/P1, compiles sparse support, jointly solves target inventory, and selects one complete Maker bundle by strict DeltaBasketScore v2.

production_contract.candidate_boundary_role: bounded search limit only, maximum two layers per side
production_contract.final_support_role: sparse support selected by calibrated probability and joint economic value
production_contract.center_stability_gate: OOS-promoted center lead threshold; below threshold direction is NEUTRAL
production_contract.target_inventory: single joint full-scenario optimization; no equal split, fixed bucket count, or separately added role budgets
production_contract.execution_unit: complete Maker bundle containing every positive inventory gap
production_contract.urgent_fok: single bucket only after confirmed Maker cancellation

probability_training_proxy.calibration_rule: only actual-model errors with event_day strictly earlier than the scored event; global cold-start plus station shrinkage

module_activation.policy: choose on 2026-07-14..16 promotion slice, require 2026-07-17 audit; otherwise fall back to simpler prior

evidence_boundary: signed order limit, original cash, shares, and creation time are exact public signed-order facts
CLOB prices-history is a reference series, not executable historical depth or queue
proxy probability is public-model evidence, not the wallet's private probability
behavioral fit is not weather accuracy, settlement win rate, or PnL
the 45-station model calibration window is eight summer days and is not a cross-season long-run station model database

awc_global_primary_contract.allowed_stage: P0, P0-M, P1 and pure-YES basket hard-fact exclusions via production_no_live SSOT
